remarks: Charming 2-Bed, 2.5-Bath 2-Story Townhouse! Welcome to your new home! This delightful 2-story townhouse presents the perfect blend of comfort and style, ideal for modern living. Spacious Living Area The open-concept layout boasts a generous living room, perfect for entertaining or relaxing with family. Large windows fill the space with natural light, creating a warm and inviting atmosphere. The well-appointed kitchen features sleek countertops, stainless steel appliances, and ample cabinetry, making it a chef's dream. An adjacent dining area is perfect for enjoying meals with loved ones. Upstairs, you'll find two beautifully designed bedrooms, each with its own en-suite bathroom. A convenient half bath on the main floor adds to the functionality of the home, ideal for guests and everyday use. Enjoy outdoor living on your private patio, perfect for grilling, gardening, or simply unwinding after a long day. The townhouse includes a 1-car attached garage, providing secure parking and extra storage space. The community features beautifully landscaped common areas, with a pool and tennis court. Centrally located, this townhouse is just minutes from shopping, dining, and local parks, offering easy access to everything you need. Don't miss the opportunity to make this charming townhouse your new home.
